signal: Dash Technologies builds connected healthcare platforms for remote care and clinical data, growing to over 550 employees with AI and cloud services

email.body1:
Danial, saw Dash keeps scaling its connected healthcare and AI engineering services past 550 people.

Growth like that usually means more in-market medtech and health organizations than your BD team can develop at once, and that is where pipeline goes cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up on its own, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Dash off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Danial, quick follow-up for Dash.

As services demand grows, the number tends to climb faster than the team can ramp, and most BD reps cannot say exactly how many meetings they need to hit it. The gap shows up late, and the quarter becomes a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Dash needs to close that gap this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Danial, last bit of proof for Dash.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Dash's reply rate likely compares to other B2B tech teams. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?

Danial, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount is not a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Timing is everything, and I know a fast-growing services team stays busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your motion? I will tailor it to Dash either way.
